title: The Place of the Individual in the New World of the Behavioral Sciences
coreMove: Judge any human system by whether it protects the individual's capacity to become a person.
sourcePressure: The closing chapter defends the individual person inside a world increasingly shaped by scientific systems, prediction, and control. chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Ending with anti-science alarm or vague celebration of individuality.
